title: HandLive — relay op pair_revoked (relay → device)
description: 0.7.3, PAIR-03 API 4, SET-02 API 5: the pair has been revoked; sent as soon as it happens and again when the device reconnects (pairs revoked within 30 days, revoked_notice). Repeats are ignored.

by.description: device_id of the device that revoked the pair.
